title: Final Probabilities
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct ratio of probabilities for H+, H0, and H- as 1 : 2e^371 : e^240.

title: Work Function Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the work function value that gives equal probabilities to H0 and H- as 0.6 eV.

title: Chemical Equilibrium Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the chemical equilibrium conditions involving chemical potentials.

title: Statistical Mechanics Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply statistical mechanics principles to derive the probabilities of H+, H0, and H-.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all energy values are expressed in consistent units (eV).

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the chemical potential calculations.

title: Significant Figures
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must provide answers with the correct number of significant figures, specifically one significant figure.
